description: The lowest priced rows that meet the given minimums, ranked by estimated monthly USD.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes the offer is available in.

gpu_model.description: Substring of the GPU model, e.g. h100

new.description: Only offers first seen within this window: 24h, 7d, 2w (a bare number is days). Pair with sort=new for the newest first.

platform.description: Where the row was read: api, whmcs, openserver…

q.description: A sentence or keywords: "2 vcpu 4gb under $10 in germany". Parsed into the fields below; explicit fields win.

region.description: A region word (eu, europe, asia, north america, nordics, dach…) expanded to countries.

stock.description: discontinued = the provider no longer lists the plan; hidden unless asked for by name
